AA.recommendation: Markedly reduced morphine production leading to lack of analgesic effect. Use alternative non-opioid or alternative opioid.

AG.recommendation: Reduced morphine formation. Monitor response closely or adjust dosage.

GG.recommendation: Normal enzymatic conversion. Standard therapeutic dose recommended.

AA.recommendation: Substantially reduced active metabolite exposure. High risk of cardiovascular events/stent thrombosis. Alternative antiplatelet (e.g., Prasugrel, Ticagrelor) recommended.

AG.recommendation: Reduced platelet inhibition. Alternative antiplatelet recommended.

GG.recommendation: Normal platelet inhibition response. Standard therapeutic dose recommended.

CC.recommendation: Markedly elevated plasma concentrations of simvastatin acid. High risk of myopathy/rhabdomyolysis. Prescribe lower dose or switch to pravastatin/rosuvastatin.

CT.recommendation: Intermediate plasma levels. Avoid doses exceeding 20 mg daily.

TT.recommendation: Typical hepatic uptake. Standard dosing guidelines apply.
